new_value: Chevron Corp [36.4%]; Azule Energy [27.2%]; Sonangol EP [22.8%]; TotalEnergies SE [13.6%]
source_notes: In 2022 BP and Eni combined their Angolan upstream/LNG interests into the 50:50 JV Azule Energy, which now holds their participation in Angola LNG. The Angola LNG operator site lists current shareholders as Sonangol, Chevron, TotalEnergies, and Azule Energy. Azule's 27.2% = the former BP 13.6% + Eni 13.6% combined (arithmetic from the 2008 stakes; the operator site shows the partnership but does not publish exact %). Chevron 36.4% / Sonangol 22.8% / TotalEnergies 13.6% unchanged. YELLOW because the 27.2% is implied (combination), not stated explicitly by a primary source.
scope_note: Single-unit project. Entity 'Azule Energy' should be created (see entity file). Update ParentHQCountry to drop the separate BP/Eni split if Azule is treated as one entity (Azule HQ: Angola).
